_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id} nan Tic Tac Toe pou twa jwè.
Senbòl ou a se '{symbol}'.
Ou pran tou pou mete senbòl ou sou yon bwa 5x5 pou fòme yon liy de kat.
Liy yo ka orizontal, vètikal, oswa dyagonal.
Soumèt mouvman ou a nan fòma '[4]' pou make selil 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format mouvman ki pa valab. Sèvi ak "[cell]" kote selil la 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nimewo selil ki pa valab: {cell}. Li dwe ant 0 ak {max_cell} .
invalid_move.made_invalid: Jwè {player_id} te fè yon mouvman ki pa valab.

game_action.placed: Jwè {player_id} mete senbòl li ({symbol}) nan chan ({row}, {col}).

outcome.draw: Jwèt la se yon match nul!
